title: 2014 HMMT November Guts Problem 9
statement: Let \(f\) be a function from the nonnegative integers to the positive reals such that \(f(x+y)=f(x) \cdot f(y)\) holds for all nonnegative integers \(x\) and \(y\). If \(f(19)=524288 k\), find \(f(4)\) in terms of \(k\).

solutions.text:
\(16 k^{4 / 19}\) The given condition implies \(f(m n)=f(m)^{n}\), so

\[f(4)^{19}=f(4 \cdot 19)=f(19 \cdot 4)=f(19)^{4}\]

and it follows that \(f(4)=16 k^{4 / 19}\).
